releases.body:
✨ New Features
Per-event-type notification delay (delayMs)
Notifications now support configurable delays per event type, solving the issue where notifications appear before the TUI finishes rendering results.

"delayMs": {
    "idle": 1500,       // Wait 1.5s for long responses to finish rendering
    "error": 500,       // Short delay for error details
    "permission": 800,  // Wait for context to render before prompting
    "question": 800,    // Same for questions
    "cancel": 0,        // No delay needed
    "subagent": 1000    // Wait for subagent results
}

Set any value to 0 to disable delay for that event type. These are the new defaults — no configuration required for the improved experience.
Session-scoped throttle
Notification throttle is now scoped per session instead of globally. Previously, a notification in session A would suppress the same event type in session B within the throttle window. Now, different sessions notify independently — only repeated events within the same session are throttled.
📝 Configuration
The filter.minInterval setting now applies per (session, eventType) pair instead of globally. Its semantics changed from "minimum seconds between same-type notifications anywhere" to "minimum seconds between same-type notifications in the same session".
📦 Full Changelog
- Add delayMs config option with per-event-type delay (default: idle 1500ms, error 500ms, permission 800ms, question 800ms, cancel 0ms, subagent 1000ms)
- Change throttle key from eventType to sessionID:eventType for session-scoped dedup
- Update alert.schema.json with delayMs schema definition

✨ New Features
- Emoji notification titles — Notification titles now include emoji prefixes for instant visual distinction between event types:
  - ✅ Task Completed
  - ❌ Error Occurred
  - 🔑 Permission Required
  - ❓ Question
  - 🚫 Cancelled
  - 🤖 Subagent Done
- Windows AUMID auto-registration — Plugin automatically registers AppUserModelId in Windows registry (HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\OpenCode) on first run, including DisplayName and IconUri. This enables stable Windows Toast notifications.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fix notification source showing "Windows PowerShell" — Toast notifications now call SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID('OpenCode') via shell32.dll, so Windows correctly attributes notifications to OpenCode instead of the PowerShell process.
- Fix "new session" timestamp appearing in notifications — Session title enrichment is now skipped when the title is a default "new session" value, preventing meaningless timestamps from showing in notification messages.
- Remove redundant "OpenCode" prefix from notification titles — The "OpenCode" text was prepended to titles, pushing emoji out of the leftmost position. The application identity is now handled by the OS notification system (AUMID / Toast notifier) instead.
🔧 Internal
- Replace execSync with spawn+detached in sendWindowsToast (later reverted to execSync after AUMID fix resolved the stability issue)

Bug Fixes
- Handle question.asked and permission.asked events directly — Instead of relying on heuristic detection (parsing assistant messages for question marks or question starters), the plugin now natively handles question.asked and permission.asked event types from the OpenCode SDK. This makes question and permission detection reliable and immediate. (a555eaf)
- Prevent permission events from being dropped or type-mutated — Previously, enrichFromSession would skip notification for child sessions unconditionally, and the heuristic-based question detection could mutate a permission event into question. Now child session filtering only applies to idle events, and question detection no longer overwrites other event types. (aa59a72)
Changed
- Removed the permission.ask hook from index.ts — permission events are now captured through the standard event hook via permission.asked, eliminating the redundant separate handler.
- Removed heuristic-based question detection helpers (extractTextFromParts, isQuestionText) and the session.messages API call in enrichFromSession — question detection is now handled directly by the question.asked event type.
- Updated repository URLs from ZhouDate/opencode-alert to ThinkDonk/opencode-alert.
Added
- 7 new test cases covering permission.asked and question.asked event parsing with various payload shapes (with/without permission details, with/without header, missing questions array, etc.).

Docs
- update package.json
- update repository URLs to ZhouDate/opencode-alert

Bug Fixes
- Fix Windows notifications not working: Bun's $ template tag was expanding PowerShell variables ($template, $xml, $toast) as shell variables, breaking the command. Windows desktop notifications now use execSync directly.
- Fix notification channels being mutually exclusive: OSC/Toast and desktop notifications were if/else-if, meaning only one channel could fire. Now they're additive — both can fire simultaneously.
- Fix if (!$) return; blocking Windows path: Windows uses spawn/execSync and doesn't need Bun's $, but the guard was blocking all platforms.
- Add BalloonTip fallback on Windows: WinRT Toast is tried first; if it fails (older Windows, missing runtime), automatically falls back to System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon BalloonTip.
What's New (since v0.1.0)
- Zero-build architecture (no tsup, Bun runs TS natively)
- Zero runtime dependencies (removed node-notifier)
- OSC in-terminal notifications (777/9/99) with tmux passthrough
- Terminal focus detection (suppress when foreground)
- Debounce (suppress idle within 3s of permission/error/question)
- Cancel and subagent event types
- Config auto-generation on first run
- soundCommand for cross-platform custom sound playback
- suppressWhenFocused, notifyOnIdle, notifyChildSessions config fields
- OSC content sanitization (C0/C1 control character stripping)
- 92 test cases (up from 48)
Breaking Changes (from v0.1.0)
- Removed node-notifier peer dependency
- Removed build / dev / prepublishOnly scripts
- main points to ./index.ts (no more dist/)
